summary: @onereach/get-version-data ships obfuscated payload executed via alternate runtime at preinstall
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (pinned to v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun into a tempdir and then invokes `bun math_init.js` against a sibling file at the package root. math_init.js is a 727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle heavily obfuscated with a numeric/character-code lookup array and a string-array rotation function (`WV8StW`). The filename has no relationship to the package's declared purpose (a CLI to fetch version data), and the file sits outside the author's declared `files: ["src"]` manifest despite being shipped in the published tarball. The wrapper setup.mjs is itself obfuscator.io-style variable-renamed. On `npm install`, the alternate Bun runtime executes the opaque 727 KB payload with the installer's privileges, evading Node-based static and runtime scanners. The combination of preinstall lifecycle execution, alternate-runtime dropper, obfuscated purpose-mismatched payload, and undeclared tarball blob outside the files allowlist is the loader/dropper shape, not a legitimate build step.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
